human.problem: This two-blank card asks the baker to fill in 'love both ___ and ___' with truth and peace. The two right words can go in either order and mean the same thing. If a baker puts 'peace' in blank 1 and 'truth' in blank 2, the card's blank numbers would mark it wrong, even though the baker could fairly argue it's right.
human.question: When the two right answers of a two-blank card can be swapped without changing the meaning, should the card be rewritten so only one order works, or should the app accept either order?
